correctness.rationale: For the exact matching-replacement Builder–Chooser game on P_n n>=2 or C_n n>=4, surviving cross edges are unit gaps of a matching; triangles after growth are pairwise edge-disjoint. h>=2 is precisely existence of winning two-color assignment. For h triangles, inclusion-exclusion gives 2^(m+k-3h)(8^h-2*7^h+6^h) winning ordered assignments. Linear gap stars-and-bars and cyclic distinguished-edge counting yield the formulas for a_P(n,k,j), a_C(n,k,j), exceptional alternating perfect matchings and the two rational generating functions. Dominant weighted matching pole gives exponential random-plan win. Independent n<=12 matching profiles checked; unrestricted statements rest on combinatorial proof.
residual_risks: Bounded finite experiments do not prove unrestricted quantification; proof reconstruction includes stated critical lemmas.
